content.text:
Fixed and verified green.

**The bug:** `isDark` lived only in React state (`useState(false)`), so every page load started in light mode.

**The fix** — three small changes in `target-app/src/App.tsx`:

1. `readStoredTheme()` (App.tsx:16) reads `kane-notes-theme` from `localStorage`, wrapped in try/catch so blocked storage (private mode, cookies disabled) degrades to light instead of crashing the app.
2. `useState(readStoredTheme)` (App.tsx:31) seeds initial state from storage — passed as a lazy initializer so the read happens once on mount, not on every render.
3. The existing theme effect (App.tsx:41) now writes the value back alongside setting `document.body.dataset.theme`, so the toggle and the stored value can't drift apart.

Kane's browser run confirms the full flow: toggle dark → hard navigate to a fresh page → background is still dark.

One thing I left alone, worth flagging: on reload there's a brief light flash before React mounts and the effect runs, since `body` starts light per `index.css:22`. The usual fix is an inline script in `index.html` that stamps `data-theme` before the bundle loads — but `target-app/CLAUDE.md` scopes edits to `./src`, so I didn't touch it. Say the word if you want it and I'll confirm the scope with you first.
